title: Every figure tool, one page
subtitle: Real output from each tool the figures skill routes to. Use the theme button at the bottom right, or open it on a phone: every figure follows the page.

sections.title: Pele: most diagrams and simple charts
sections.intro: Mermaid text drawn by the vendored Pele engine inside the page. No image file: the colours come from the page, so they switch with the theme, and the layout adapts to the width.

blocks.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Client
    UI[Web app]
    Cache[(Local cache)]
  end
  subgraph Services
    API[API gateway]
    Auth[Auth service]
    Orders[Order service]
  end
  subgraph Storage
    DB[(Orders DB)]
  end
  UI --> API
  UI --> Cache
  API --> Auth
  API --> Orders
  Orders --> DB
  Auth -. token .-> UI
blocks.caption: Flowchart: a client, its services and storage. From references/pele/flowchart.md.
